title: Agenomic knowledge retrieval event payload (v0.4)
description: The payload of a `knowledge.retrieve` event, `agenomic.knowledge_retrieval_event/v1` (RFC 0014). It carries references and digests only, never retrieved text and never the query text: the query is identified by `knowledge_query_digest`. A surface that flattens event attributes (a live tracing span) copies every member except `schema` under the same name. `knowledge_base_id` and `knowledge_version` are set when the retrieval targets exactly one knowledge base version, and are null for an agent-scoped retrieval across several bases. `knowledge_manifest_digest` and `knowledge_execution_key` are null outside agent-scoped retrieval, and the key is also null for an agent-scoped retrieval that names no execution. `knowledge_refs` lists the returned evidence in rank order, ranks starting at 1.

ref.description: One returned piece of evidence. `content_digest` is the chunk content digest (sha256 of the chunk text bytes) when `chunk_id` is set, and the section content digest when a whole section was returned (`chunk_id` null). `score_ppm` is the fused score scaled to parts per million of the best attainable score: it is rank derived, never a calibrated probability.
